source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Thanks for replying.

To clarify the scope, I need the existing report transformed into a polished, premium, editable template that looks and feels like a professional paid assessment. Because the report content already exists, this is not a full copywriting assignment; the focus should be its design, layout, structure, and editability.

The main requirements are as follows:

\- Front-page results panel

A prominent score/dashboard panel should appear on the first page. It must display the customer's vehicle security score, risk band, exposure level, priority level, main reason for the rating, and primary weaknesses, allowing the customer to understand the result immediately upon opening the report.

\- Consistent page furniture

Every page needs a clean, consistent header and footer containing the report name, report ID, vehicle group, confidential/restricted status, assessment date, and page number.

\- Transparent scoring summary

Please include a clear table listing the main scoring categories, maximum score, customer score, and total score so the assessment appears transparent and professional.

\- Action-led upgrade path

Rather than being purely informational, the recommendations should be practical and clearly prioritised, ideally as immediate actions, priority upgrades, and secondary upgrades.

\- Fully editable templates

Editability is essential because I will update the reports for different customers. Fields that I need to change include the vehicle registration, assessment date, report ID, vehicle group, security score, risk band, category scores, weaknesses, recommendations, and customer-specific notes.

\- Several report variants

Please create editable versions for DX17, DX18, DX19, and DX20 so I can choose the appropriate template according to the customer's score or risk level.

The completed files must be straightforward to edit and export as a PDF. Canva or PowerPoint may be the best option, although I am open to another format if you recommend something more suitable.

Could you please confirm:

\- Whether you can help with this type of project
\- Which file format you recommend
\- What materials you need from me before beginning
\- The estimated cost
\- The estimated timescale
\- Whether all fonts, icons, and design assets required for future editing will be included in the final files

Once I know the project is a good fit, I can send the existing sample report and any reference images.

Thanks

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
I have reviewed the changes, and everything looks good. Please now provide editable Canva templates and final PDF exports for DX17, DX18, DX19 and DX20.

The complete package should also contain all fonts, icons, logos, colour codes and other necessary design assets, allowing me to edit and export future customer reports myself. Once everything has been delivered, we can conclude the project and I will release the funds.

Thanks

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi,

Please provide the fonts, icons, logo files and colour codes. I am ready to sign off and add a bonus for your hard work, and I will do both as soon as I receive those assets.

Thanks
